cases.root_cause: Manufacturing defect during the etching process or physical damage post-fabrication leading to broken traces, resulting in a NET_OPEN_DETECTED error.
resolution: Immediate rework action: Repair the broken trace sections to restore electrical continuity.
Verification action: Perform continuity testing and visual inspection to ensure the repair is successful and no other open circuits exist.
Process feedback action: Review the etching and handling processes to prevent over-removal of copper and physical damage to traces.

cases.root_cause: Manufacturing process defect leading to spurious copper deposition or incomplete etching, resulting in isolated copper fragments between adjacent traces.
resolution: Review and adjust the etching process parameters to ensure complete removal of unintended copper.
Implement stricter automated optical inspection (AOI) to detect and flag spurious copper fragments before final assembly.
Clean the affected boards to remove residual conductive fragments if possible, or scrap boards with unrecoverable short risks.

cases.root_cause: Improper depanelization or mechanical stress during manufacturing caused a piece of the copper/substrate to break off, resulting in a mousebite defect on the outer copper trace.
resolution: Review and adjust the depanelization process to minimize mechanical stress on the board edges.
Increase the clearance between the outer copper traces and the panelization breakaway tabs in the CAD layout.
Inspect affected boards for localized resistance increases and structural weakness at the defect site.

cases.root_cause: Manufacturing defect during the etching process leaving excess copper, creating a spur protrusion.
resolution: Remove the spur protrusion to restore required electrical clearance.
Calibrate etching process to prevent excess copper retention.

cases.root_cause: Incomplete etching during the PCB manufacturing process resulted in residual spurious copper fragments and bridges between signal traces, violating electrical clearance rules and causing short circuits.
resolution: Review and adjust the PCB etching process parameters to ensure complete removal of unintended copper between traces.
Implement stricter Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) to detect spurious copper fragments and bridges before final assembly.
Rework the affected prototype boards by carefully removing the residual copper bridges to restore the required electrical clearance.

cases.root_cause: Manufacturing process issue (likely etching or plating) resulting in a localized copper void (pin-hole) on the trace, causing increased resistance.
resolution: Immediate rework action: Repair the pin-hole void on the affected copper trace to restore the required cross-sectional area.
Verification action: Perform continuity and resistance testing on the repaired trace to ensure it meets current carrying capacity requirements.
Process feedback action: Review and adjust the etching and plating process controls to prevent localized copper voids in future manufacturing runs.
